best_for: Windows admins and developers who SSH into Linux servers all day and want tabs, SFTP, an X server and Unix tools in one window, and who can live with the free edition's caps.
description:
MobaXterm is a remote-access toolbox for Windows from Mobatek, a company that has made it since 2008. The free Home edition is freeware.

Need a tool the terminal lacks? Its package manager, MobApt, works like apt-get and pulls in more Unix programs, and free plugins add others. The terminal can color keywords in a log file even when the remote server has no color support, and you can write your own highlighting rules. A graphical manager sets up SSH port forwarding without long commands. You can reach a remote Unix desktop over XDMCP, and the X server handles OpenGL, Composite and RandR for heavier graphical apps.

points.title: One window for remote work
points.text: MobaXterm bundles a tabbed terminal with Unix commands, a session manager for SSH, RDP, VNC, Telnet, FTP, SFTP and serial, and a built-in X11 server. Remote Linux graphical apps open on your Windows desktop with no DISPLAY setup.

points.title: Files beside the shell
points.text: An SFTP browser opens next to each SSH session for drag-and-drop transfers, and the bundled editor can change remote files over SSH directly.

points.title: Home edition has hard caps
points.text: The free Home edition allows at most 12 saved sessions, 2 SSH tunnels and 4 macros, and built-in TFTP, NFS and Cron servers stop after 360 seconds. Heavy users hit the session cap first.

points.title: Professional is a one-time buy
points.text: Professional costs USD 69 per user, before tax, with volume discounts. It removes the caps, adds tighter security settings and deployment inside a company, and gives a lifetime right to use with 12 months of updates. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Run commands on many servers
points.text: Multi-execution sends the same typing to several servers at once, macros replay keystrokes, and SSH gateway support reaches hosts behind a jump server. Saved passwords sit behind a master password.

points.title: Windows only
points.text: There is no Mac or Linux version. The download listed here is a zip archive of the 32-bit build, and the Windows listing keeps 24 versions.
